verdict.rationale: Glama's Gateway says every call through it is "credential-managed," which points to first-party credential handling for downstream tools, but nothing explains how it works. The inspector's OAuth 2.1 support is a testing feature, not platform-run OAuth with vaulting, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation that the platform runs OAuth authorization flows for downstream tools, encrypted credential vaulting, automatic token refresh, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let the platform run OAuth flows for downstream tools and vault the resulting credentials encrypted, with automatic token refresh

citations.quote: Every call through this URL is logged, access-controlled, and credential-managed
